title: Das Johannesbuch der Mandäer (German, Lidzbarski 1915)
author: Mark Lidzbarski
description: Mark Lidzbarski's German edition of the Mandaean Book of John. The text introduces a distinctive religious literature in which John the Baptist appears within teachings about revelation, ritual and the world of light.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/das-johannesbuch-der-mandaer).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
